items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So I went into Dallas and got to talking to Bernie one time and he said, Ernie

ctx.x: So I'd say I live here; well, you don't belong here, 168.

So I went into Dallas and got to talking to Bernie one time and he said, Ernie, I think I have about fourteen pieces in the band, you have enough people; I think all you need is twelve people and he said the nice thing about it, with your band is, if there is somebody else around there that would like to be union, some of the teachers or this or that or something, and so I came back and started talking around and Spurgeon West was president of our first local; A.G. Rogers who was a teacher there was a musician…
That was your black local number?
